subject.title: test(browser): replace broad win32 skip with dynamic directory symlink check

question: Should maintainers accept the low automation risk and merge this test-only PR after checks are green, or require native Windows proof for the browser junction path first?
rationale: The patch matches an accepted sibling pattern and has no code finding, but only a maintainer can decide whether focused non-Windows terminal output is enough for a Windows test-gating change.

options.title: Merge After Green Checks
options.body: Accept the low test-harness risk once required checks are green because the current head mirrors the accepted sibling probe pattern.

options.title: Request Native Windows Proof
options.body: Ask for a native Windows focused run showing this browser symlink case executes with junction support instead of skipping.

options.title: Pause Until CI Is Clean
options.body: Leave the PR open but unmerged until the unrelated lint failure is rerun or resolved on the base branch.

recommendation.title: Merge After Green Checks
recommendation.body: Accept the low test-harness risk once required checks are green because the current head mirrors the accepted sibling probe pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: The live PR is currently assigned to steipete, so they are the clearest owner for the merge-risk/proof choice.
